timerfd_create.description: These system calls create and operate on a timer that delivers  timer expiration notifications via a file descriptor. They  provide an alternative to the use of setitimer(2) or  timer_create(2), with the advantage that the file descriptor may  be monitored by select(2), poll(2), and epoll(7).
